title: Fix unresponsive Create Profile screen

requirements.text: Diagnose and fix the ProfileSetupModal so that submitting a display name (and optional avatar URL) successfully calls the backend registerUser function and transitions the user into the main chat layout without the form becoming unresponsive or hanging.

quotes: The app is not responding on create profile

acceptanceCriteria: After Internet Identity login, the ProfileSetupModal renders and the input fields are interactive.
Submitting a valid display name triggers the registerUser backend call without the UI freezing or the button becoming permanently disabled.
On successful registration, the modal closes and the user is taken to the main ChatLayout.
If the backend call fails, an error message is displayed and the form remains usable for retry.
The submit button shows a loading indicator while the mutation is in flight and re-enables after completion.
The useAuthFlow hook correctly reflects the newly registered state so the app does not re-show the ProfileSetupModal after registration.

constraints: Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts.
Do not alter the backend registerUser function signature or existing data model.
nonGoals: Adding new profile fields beyond display name and avatar URL.
Changing the overall authentication or login flow.
Modifying any other screen or feature outside the profile creation path.
